# Hindustan Projects
> India's premier turnkey construction, civil engineering, and infrastructure firm.

## Overview
Hindustan Projects (HiPRO) is an engineering and infrastructure company specializing in residential construction, high-rise commercial complexes, industrial facilities, and master turnkey project execution across India.

## Key Services
- Civil & Structural Engineering: RCC design, heavy foundation engineering, seismic damping, and high-load structural frameworks.
- Commercial Development: Corporate headquarters, IT tech parks, retail shopping malls, and hospitality centers.
- Residential Construction: Turnkey luxury villas, multi-storey apartment complexes, and gated community townships.
- Industrial Infrastructure: Modern warehouses, manufacturing facilities, pre-engineered steel buildings (PEB), and industrial estates.
- Turnkey Design & Build: Architectural planning, 3D BIM modeling, sanction approvals, and interior fit-outs.

## Key Tools & Features
- Cost Estimator: Package-based calculator providing accurate construction cost estimates per square foot across Indian cities.
- Project Portfolio: Verified case studies detailing executed square footage, location, timelines, and architectural specifications.
- Quality & Safety Assurance: 470+ quality checkpoints, milestone-based escrow payments, and ISO-compliant engineering standards.
